001: Hi, Carlos. Have you seen the new apartment yet?
Yes, Laura, I visited it yesterday. It's quite bright.
That's great! And does it have a balcony or a terrace?
It has a small terrace, but it faces south.
I'm really glad. Light is very important to me.
Me too. That's why I decided on this apartment.
002: Excuse me, can you help me with something?
Sure, tell me. What do you need?
I'm looking for a sofa for the living room.
And what style do you like more, modern or classic?
I prefer something modern, but comfortable.
Then I recommend checking out that store downtown.
003: It's a three-bedroom apartment on the third floor without an elevator.
No elevator? That must be tiring.
Yeah, it's hard at first, but then you get used to it.
I think I'd prefer a ground-floor place with a garden.
To each their own, that's for sure.
004: Marta, have you put up pictures on the walls yet?
Not yet, I'm waiting to paint first.
And what color are you going to paint the living room?
I want a light gray tone, very soft.
That will look really elegant with wooden furniture.
I hope so. I'll show you the result!
005: Can you lend me your vacuum cleaner this weekend?
Sure, but mine is a bit old and noisy.
That's fine, it's just for a quick clean.
And wouldn't you rather I help you clean?
That's not necessary, but thanks for offering.
You're welcome. Let me know if you change your mind.
006: I love your kitchen, it's very spacious.
Thanks, it's what I like most about the house.
And do you cook a lot at home?
Yes, almost every day. Cooking relaxes me.
Well, you'll have to invite me over to try something someday.
Of course! I'll make you my favorite dish.
007: Have you managed to fix the blind in the bedroom?
Not yet, I called the handyman but he's not answering.
What a pain. And can't you do it yourself?
I'd rather not risk it, I don't want to break it more.
You're right, better to leave it to a professional.
Yeah, I hope he calls me back soon to sort it out.
008: Sofía, does your room face the street or the courtyard?
It faces the inner courtyard, so it's very quiet.
Lucky you. Mine faces a busy avenue.
And doesn't the noise bother you at night?
Sometimes it does, but I've gotten used to it.
I honestly couldn't sleep with that noise.
009: What furniture are you still missing for the dining room?
I just need a bookshelf for the books.
Have you looked at any second-hand stores?
Yes, but I can't find one I like.
Sometimes there are really good things online.
That's true, I'll keep looking there.
010: Do you like the neighborhood where you live?
Yes, a lot. There's everything nearby: shops and parks.
And does public transportation work well?
Pretty well, the subway is five minutes from me.
That's a big advantage for everyday life.
No doubt. I wouldn't trade it for anything.
